item.title: Gokaldas Exports, KPR Mill, Vardhman, other textile stocks fall up to 5%; here’s why
item.description: According to its Q3FY26 earnings presentation, Gokaldas reported EBITDA slipped 18 per cent year-on-year to Rs 96 crore, primarily because the company had to share a considerable portion of the US tariff burden with its key customers.

item.title: India not likely to join Trump’s Board of Peace for Gaza meeting on Feb 19: Report
item.description: Several countries signed the charter for the Board of Peace at Davos earlier this year, including Pakistan, Argentina, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bulgaria, Hungary, Indonesia, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Paraguay, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, UAE, Uzbekistan, and Mongolia.

item.title: India’s AI talent gap: Only 5,000 core AI engineers in a pool of 20,000, says Xpheno
item.description: “As agentic AI tools and LLM processes mature, the potential of AI replacing human role-holders will increase,” according to Kamal Karanth, co-founder of Xpheno.

item.title: Passenger vehicle sales rise 7% in Jan; two-wheelers see 21% jump
item.description: Maruti Suzuki leads the charge with 42% market share in January while Hyundai Motor India reclaimed the second spot with sales of 65,914 cars.

item.title: Delhi's luxury hotel pricing hits new peak during AI Summit; rates skyrocket to Rs 30,00,000
item.description: On Tuesday morning, a quick scan of bookings of Delhi's hotel websites threw up numbers that usually belong to once-a-year calendar moments, except this wasn’t New Year’s Eve or a big wedding weekend

item.title: Explained: Why the US-Bangladesh deal is a problem for India, what it means, its impact
item.description: Bangladesh's base reciprocal tariff will stand at 19 per cent, slightly higher than India's 18 per cent, but that is not easing the stress in India's policy circles. Here's why

item.title: ‘Taxed like they’re legal, regulated like they’re illegal’: Raghav Chadha says crypto, stablecoin must be legalised
item.description: Raghav Chadha said there is no dedicated licencing law, no investor protection, no dedicated anti-money laundering (AML) framework, and no explicit legal classification for virtual digital assets.

item.title: NSE IPO: MOFSL shares earnings growth estimates post Q3 results
item.description: NSE: MOFSL raised its earnings estimates to reflect the current volume run rate, forecasting a compound annual growth rate of 15 per cent in revenue, 14 per cent in Ebitda, and 15 per cent in reported PAT over FY26‑28.

item.title: FPI flows reverse, Rs 11,600 crore equity inflows in February: Will the trend sustain?
item.description: Data showed that FPIs were net sellers of domestic equities worth Rs 1,66,286 crore in 2025, after being net buyers to the tune of Rs 1,10,813 crore in 2024.
